description: Public demo / template / practice forms used for real-world compatibility testing (docs: REAL_WORLD_TESTING_REPORT.md). None is a company's live questionnaire, none needs an account, and none is ever submitted: the harness never passes submit=True, FormFiller never presses a final-action button, and every walk runs with the network guard on. Fictional data only.

forms.exercises: company-fact questions, custom radio group (business type), file upload, phone widget

forms.name: OpnForm - Scholarship Application (multi-page template preview)
forms.exercises: multi-page Next navigation in a Vue app; personal (non-company) questions that must stay in review

forms.exercises: company-fact questions, address block, radio group, textareas
